about.title: Why another insurance company?
text: We started Everyone's Insurance in 2010 because we felt that there was a better way. We aimed to give the lowest prices, provide great customer service, and be an advocate for the customer. Yeah, we had heard that before, too.
So we set out to be driven by a simple question: with what kind of insurance company would we want to do business, and how far could we go to be that company?

Everything we do, from the inside out, is about redefining how insurance is approached in a more customer driven model. We have longer hours. We represent multiple companies that all compete for your business. We always give the lowest price among the best companies available. Our amazing staff is handpicked and empowered to treat you as they would want to be treated.
Since we all have heard this before, we know that the only way to be different is to actually prove it every day. This is who we are and this is why Everyone's Insurance was created.

faqs.a: Call Monday through Saturday. We are available 9 AM to 5 PM for customer service and 9 AM to 9 PM for sales.

faqs.q: Can I come to the office?
faqs.a: Yes. Please feel free to stop by Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM, at 651 N Egret Bay Blvd, Suite K in League City.

faqs.q: Do you only cover League City?
faqs.a: No. We serve all of Texas. League City is where our physical location is.

faqs.q: How do I start a quote?
faqs.a: Stop by, give us a call, or complete the quote request form and we will begin the quoting process.

faqs.q: What do you need from me for a quote?
faqs.a: The type of insurance you are asking about, along with your name, address, email, phone and date of birth.
